title: Glyphstorm: ASCII  twin-stick shooter
author: christophermarin
selftext:
Happy to share a little game I cooked up. Everything on screen is text glyphs, and that includes the bosses. Enemies break apart into matter that upgrades your gun.

* 17 arenas: torus wrap, Möbius flip, curved planetoid, tornado, tilting table, sloped floors that push you around
* Original synthwave soundtrack, with one theme per arena
* Daily challenge and leaderboards
*  Keyboard, gamepad or touch

It's vanilla TypeScript with no engine and no dependencies. 

Feedback welcome, especially on difficulty.  
[https://glyphstorm.com/](https://glyphstorm.com/)
